thread:
maria: Quick FYI: PR ready to land that clarifies function-calling behavior when an array contains nullable union items. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4824. Need docs reviewers + SDK snippet sync.

alex: On it. I'll update Python + JS snippets. Do we want the compact parse-first example or the explicit JSONSchema-first pattern?

maria: Both, please. Show a strict JSON Schema (using oneOf) and a relaxed shim option with parseFallback. Also call out that `null` inside arrays means an optional item, not an array-level null.

alex: Draft JS snippet pushed in my branch (linked from the PR). Snippet: 
```js
// output: { items: [ { kind: 'A', data: {...} } | null ] }
const resp = await client.call({ model: 'rwd-compact', input: prompt });
const parsed = parse(resp, schema, { allowArrayNullItems: true });
```
Will add the Python equivalent.

kevin: I'll run a quick link audit and fix cross-doc anchors (invoke-guide, parse-playbook). I already found two broken anchors in invoke-guide.

lisa: Heads-up: this is a behavioral note for SDK consumers — we need a short blurb in the v1.8.0 changelog that explains the clarification. I'll draft.

sam: Can we include a tiny unit-test snippet that asserts parser returns `null` for an explicit null entry vs missing item? I can draft a pytest example.

maria: Perfect. Also please update the quickstart that used to coerce nulls into empty objects — that was causing downstream regressions in some integration tests.

alex: Pushed the updated snippets and linked them in the PR body: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4824/files. Left a TODO for the pytest.

pr-bot: CI checks passed (docs build + snippet lint) :green_check_mark: See CI run https://ci.internal/build/9876

maria: Assigning reviewers: @lisa for release note, @kevin for links, @sam for tests, @alex for SDK snippet. If no objections I'll merge tomorrow EOD to hit the release cutoff :clock1:.

kevin: LGTM from the link side — fixed the two anchors and updated relative paths in invoke-guide.

sam: I'll push the pytest in a follow-up PR within the hour. Test will cover: present object, explicit null, and omitted index.

lisa: Release note drafted in the PR body. Tiny wording tweak suggestion: change 'array item nullability' -> 'nullable array items' to be clearer.

maria: :thumbsup: Thanks all. I'll merge after sam's quick test lands and CI is green. Marking this thread done once merged.
